LESSON: PETROL FUEL SYSTEMS

Grade: Grade 11
Subject: POWER MECHANICS
Strand: Engines (55 Lessons)
Topic 4.4: Petrol fuel Systems
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Petrol fuel Systems, part of Engines (55 Lessons) in Grade 11 POWER MECHANICS.

Key inquiry question: How is knowledge on principles of Power Mechanics applied in day-to-day life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
